title: Inventory Health
description: Stock levels, movement and gaps — on-hand by warehouse, in vs out movement trend, items out of stock and the biggest holdings.
notes: Built from Item Master (OITM), Warehouse Stock (OITW), the Inventory Journal (OINM) and open Inventory Transfer Requests (OWTQ). Quantities are in each item's stock UoM; mixed-UoM totals are indicative. Stock value, item-group and in/out value charts require the CVT_STOCK_VALUE, CVT_STOCK_MOVEMENT_MONTHLY and CVT_KPI_SUMMARY views (run scripts/sap_b1_finance_views.sql first). Stock value uses average cost from the item master.
